blocks.content: Quiz: Which of the following is the correct way to create a vector?
Tap an option below to answer:
vector<> ages = {25, 36};
Incorrect, give it another shot!
We must define the type of data we want to store in the vector inside <>.
We must define the type of data we want to store in the vector inside <>.
vector<ages> int = {25, 36};
Incorrect, give it another shot!
We define the data type inside <> while declaring the vector name outside of it.
We define the data type inside <> while declaring the vector name outside of it.
vector<int> ages = {25, 36};
Correct Answer!
This is the correct way to define a vector.
